purpose: Maintain non-interchangeable Phrygian coverage denominators and prevent false completeness claims.

views.unit: distinct TM identity labels in UD

views.scope: almost all rock/detached-stone inscriptions according to public source; small objects mostly excluded

rules: Never report a single corpus coverage percentage by dividing counts from different units.
Suffixes/subdivisions and catalogue-parent relations require identity reconciliation before object counting.
Gordion institutional category counts expose a major small-object frontier absent from the monumental index.
Mysian comparison headings remain outside Phrygian admission unless independently justified.
Canonical epigraphic count remains zero until source-level admission gates are met.
coverage_gap_statement: The project has strong machine/reference and monumental discovery layers but remains underdeveloped in source-reconciled Gordion graffiti/small-object identities and critical-edition-backed canonical records.
